description.en: Runs your RunningHub ComfyUI workflows from DSH to generate images, video and audio. Includes a panel for importing and configuring workflows, background tasks with completion notifications, and account balance and queue queries.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中调用你的 RunningHub ComfyUI 工作流生成图片、视频和音频。提供导入与配置工作流的面板、带完成通知的后台任务，以及账户余额和队列查询。
